dimensions.evidenceA: The covenant scene includes commanded approach, offerings, blood, and assent.
dimensions.evidenceB: The prophetic summary centers the exodus command on hearing God’s voice.
dimensions.label: Command remembered

dimensions.evidenceB: Jeremiah confronts temple confidence joined to injustice and disobedience.
dimensions.label: Argument setting

evidence.observation: At Sinai, burnt and peace offerings are made and their blood is called the blood of the covenant.
Jeremiah says that when God brought the ancestors from Egypt, he did not speak or command about burnt offerings and sacrifices, but commanded obedience.

record.tension: Exodus presents sacrifice inside the covenant commands, while Jeremiah’s prophetic speech says the exodus command was not about burnt offerings and sacrifices but obedience.
record.title: What did God command at the exodus?
